requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE new 1536x1024 landscape environment concept, no collage. The attached image is only a rock-drawing STYLE reference, not an edit target. Match its thick massive angular charcoal-brown rocks, bold organic black cracks, broad flat facets, thin warm ochre dirt rim, small integrated rubble. A 2D orthographic SIDE-VIEW mossy creek cavern for the same tiny teal explorer game, with more color and ecology. Tall spacious but enclosed cavern, no perspective walkway. Large quiet desaturated petrol-green backwall. Solid foreground rock above and below. Main dry walkable warm-soil bank occupies y about 650-725 in the image, broad enough for a little 70px explorer, sloping gently left to right. A shallow clear turquoise creek flows in a channel just BEHIND and below that near-bank path across x=0..1536, y=720..825, with a small rocky two-step cascade at x around 650, clear connected inlet and right outlet, restrained white flow streaks. Preserve an open readable central play space and substantial stone support under walking banks. Olive and spring-green moss patches hug damp rock, composed clusters of grass and ferns grow from bank rims, short rooted hanging vines, several little terracotta and ivory mushrooms beside wet boulders. Plants occur as separated large groups, not wallpaper. Warm dirt/charcoal rock/green growth/teal water are distinguishable color masses. Crisp confident hand-drawn contour lines, matte simple color, at most 2-3 broad value planes per shape, same rock weight as reference. NO characters: original transparent hero is placed later. No bridges, machinery, UI, text, labels, watermark, frame. No glossy3D, photorealism, pixel art, isometric perspective, blurry painting, neon purple, excessive microdetail or magical crystals. Left walking rim starts around y650, slopes to center y780, then right bank rises toward y620; chunky natural terraces with broad gentle paths rather than huge cliffs. Use three composed mushroom colonies growing from rock/soil: muted coral-orange round caps on left, several blue-green caps below mid-right ledge, ivory bracket fungi under the overhang. Little pale stems, dark simplified gills, a few cap speckles, readable silhouettes; landmark cap size120px and most20-70px, not giant trees. Dark green moss and ferns only in damp crevices, broad pale lichen patches. A narrow stream flows left-to-right along the low center basin, visible inlet AND outlet, minor short cascade and restrained flow streaks; retain dry walkable banks and a few solid stepping rocks. No characters, no objects, no text, UI, frame, magic crystals or neon bloom. More colorful than plain dirt, but huge solid gray-brown angular rocks with deep black organic cracks and 2-3 restrained flat matte facets remain visually dominant, in the same hand-drawn asset family as input. Strict orthographic SIDE VIEW not isometric, not perspective scenery, not 3D, photorealism or fuzzy painting.
